blocks.text: A bool query can combine word search with exact conditions. The word search can score relevance while filters restrict the allowed set.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.

items: A match query analyses search text using the field's text rules before finding matching documents.
A term query checks the exact indexed value. A keyword mapping is useful for exact category fields.
